title: Contracted-product clause of torsor H¹ functoriality
statement: The corresponding conjunct of lem-sc-torsor-h1-functoriality, with all its displayed hypotheses.

proof.text: Boundary-of-one representative, pushout/direct-image extension, and naturality identify the stated class.

lean.statement:
theorem torsor_h1_functoriality_contract
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{w}] [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{w})] [EnoughInjectives (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{w})]
    {T : C} (_hT : IsTerminal T)
    (G G' : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{w}) (φ : G ⟶ G')
    (eG : H G 1 ≃ _root_.Quotient (Torsor.setoid (G := G)))
    (eG' : H G' 1 ≃ _root_.Quotient (Torsor.setoid (G := G')))
    (hφ : H G 1 → H G' 1) (push : Torsor G → Torsor G') :
    ∀ P : Torsor G, eG' (hφ (eG.symm ⟦P⟧)) = ⟦push P⟧
